name: Sunken Treasure
summary: Doctor Draxlegauge sends you to Captain O'Breen, who waits at the bridge for the elven gems. After weeks among pirates, the doctor and the professor have learned that keeping pirate treasure is bad for their health.

sections.title: Treasure for the Captain
sections.body: Doctor Draxlegauge is eager to bring Captain O'Breen the elven gems. The captain waits at the bridge and wants to see them for himself. After weeks among these pirates, the doctor and the professor have learned that keeping pirate treasure is bad for their health. So Draxlegauge gives you the gems to carry to O'Breen.

faq.q: Who sends you to Captain O'Breen?
faq.answer: Doctor Draxlegauge gives you the elven gems to carry to Captain O'Breen.

faq.q: Why is Doctor Draxlegauge so eager to give up the gems?
faq.answer: After weeks among these pirates, Doctor Draxlegauge and the professor have learned that keeping pirate treasure is bad for their health.

faq.q: Where does this fall in the chain?
faq.answer: This follows the second part of Sunken Treasure, and a fourth part comes after it.
